editorial.blurb: Il Girasole Trattoria is a warm, carefully executed Italian neighborhood gem where attentive service and thoughtfully prepared food create an experience that feels genuinely special.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive after a movie or event if you want the lively bar experience—the staff excels at working you in gracefully even when busy. For special occasions, they'll go above and beyond with touches like decorating and plating dessert slices individually.
